title: Lifeline.
body: This has been my lifeline. Took me from a very tough stop 4 months ago where I was feeling totally helpless, and helped me actually start building the blocks to going back on track and feeling like I’m living a fuller life. Gaining my year back, gaining perspective back. Seeing how many new little tasks I’m able to accomplish now versus when I started fills me with joy. It’s hard to put into words. It’s a continuous experience, building a life that makes sense for you. Self kindness is the only way. The app’s inclusivity with disabilities, for example, is an extremely important key factor that made me be able to trust it and really feel and believe the kindness; in turn be able to give it back to me. Thank you, Finch.

title: Really good, but needs some tweaking
body: I downloaded this app because I was feeling deeply depressed after my cat passed away and thought it would be fun to take care of a virtual pet while taking care of myself. It’s a great idea and the focus on doing stuff for yourself little by little is a major pro, there’s no ads and no predatory pay-walls. The only thing that bothers me is, since the finch is a bird, the post-adventure chats many times include stuff speaking badly of cats and dogs. Grieving over those specific pets is really common, I’ve felt sensitive and hurt after seeing the stuff about cats, thinking of the pet I lost. I think the game could be tweaked to avoid common triggers like these. I also think there could be more resources to deal with the finch growing up, cause the baby phase is insanely cute and it’s sad to see it grow up so fast 😂 I’m having a great time overall, my streak is at 36 today and I’m gonna hatch my third micropet. The game definitely has to be localized in Spanish and Portuguese!

The team who takes care of it is really thoughtful and the game has updates and new stuff all the time. It’s implacable, definitely a 10/10
author: amongs lover

title: Se você estiver se sentindo perdido, esse app é para você
body:
Muitas vezes somos capazes de realizar coisas incríveis mas deixamos de lado o básico, este app vai te ajudar a criar a motivação necessária para superar isso e cuidar de si, porque você merece.

Note for developers: please consider expanding the localization support to include (Brazilian) Portuguese, I would love to see my friends using Finch to improve themselves but unfortunately they’re are not into English as much as I am.

title: Best self-care/tamagotchi app ever!
body: Finch has been helping me so much with my mental health lately. The idea of pairing self-care with caring for a pet is genius! In a way, when I check in on Penny (my little cute birb), I’m checking in and caring for myself, without even realizing it. Thank you so much for the devs for the amazing work! I totally recommend this to everyone! Reflecting and pausing is very important for living a more meaningful and happy life, and the app helps us to do just that.

title: Great and helpful
body: I’m using the app only for 3 days now, but I’m really enjoying it and I’m already recommending it to my friends. It is a great app, it is cute to watch baby growing up and discovering new things, and it is really helpful. The baby grows if we do things to take care of ourselves, so it is motivating. we can set goals, do quizzes about our mental health, do breathing and stretching exercises. Really good. Im using the free version because I can’t afford the premium, but I’m glad that even the free version has a lot to offer and help us. Thank you for this app, keep up the amazing work! Love from Brazil 🇧🇷 ♥️♥️
